      <title>6sense: Director, Business Solutions</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p>
<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. &nbsp;Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.&nbsp; 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.&nbsp; We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.&nbsp;</p></div><div>
<p><strong>Director, Enterprise Applications</strong></p>
<p><strong>Position Profile</strong></p>
<p><strong>Function:</strong> Business Technology — Enterprise Applications</p>
<p><strong>Reporting line:</strong> Chief Security and Business Technology Officer</p>
<p><strong>Role Purpose</strong></p>
<p>Lead the strategy, delivery and continuous improvement of 6sense’s enterprise applications, turning business priorities into secure, scalable platforms and measurable outcomes. This is a business transformation leadership role—not simply an application administration or project delivery role.</p>
<p>The Director will partner with Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal and Partner Operations to simplify processes, strengthen data quality and controls, and improve how work gets done. AI fluency and applied AI delivery are core requirements: the role must identify where AI creates value, where conventional automation is better, and where human judgment must remain accountable.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities &amp; Accountabilities</strong></p>
<p><strong>1. Enterprise Strategy &amp; Business Partnership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own a business-aligned application roadmap and investment portfolio, balancing growth, operational efficiency, risk, user experience and technical debt.</li>
<li>Partner with functional leaders to define business problems, accountable process owners, funding, expected benefits and adoption commitments before delivery begins.</li>
<li>Run transparent prioritization and portfolio reviews; challenge low-value requests and communicate trade-offs, dependencies and decisions clearly.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>2. AI-Enabled Business Transformation</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across business workflows, starting with process redesign and data readiness rather than tool selection.</li>
<li>Lead build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions with Enterprise AI Engineering, application owners, Security, Legal and Finance.</li>
<li>Set standards for discovery, prototypes, evaluation, user acceptance testing, rollout and value realization. Require evidence before moving pilots into production.</li>
<li>Champion practical AI adoption through training, workflow changes and feedback loops; distinguish estimated benefits from validated outcomes.</li>
<li>Ensure AI-enabled workflows have defined permissions, human approval points, monitoring, escalation and safe fallback paths.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3. Application Architecture, Delivery &amp; Reliability</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead business solutions partners, delivery leaders, engineers and administrators through clear ownership, shared standards and sustainable delivery practices.</li>
<li>Guide architecture for Salesforce and connected GTM and Finance systems, prioritizing maintainability, reusable integrations and trusted data flows.</li>
<li>Establish disciplined release management, testing, documentation, incident response and recovery practices for business-critical applications.</li>
<li>Reduce redundant tools, fragile integrations, legacy customizations and unsupported components; manage lifecycle and vendor dependencies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>4. Governance, Security &amp; Financial Stewardship</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to embed access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection and risk reviews into delivery and operations.</li>
<li>Align application AI use cases with 6sense’s AI Management System and applicable approval processes; document risks, controls and ownership before deployment.</li>
<li>Own application budgets, license utilization, vendor performance and total cost of ownership; consider AI usage costs as well as subscription and integration costs.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5. Leadership &amp; Operating Model</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop an accountable, learning-oriented team with strong business consulting, application engineering and applied AI capabilities.</li>
<li>Build capacity plans and effective partnerships across distributed teams and service providers.</li>
<li>Establish a product-oriented operating model that owns outcomes after launch, not just project completion.</li>
<li>Provide executive-ready reporting on portfolio health, delivered value, reliability, spend, adoption and risk.</li>
<li>Create quarterly OKRs.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Required Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p>
<p><strong>AI Competency — Essential, Not Optional</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Applied delivery: Demonstrated experience taking an AI-enabled business workflow from discovery through production, adoption and measured results—not only personal use of AI tools.</li>
<li>Solution judgment: Explain the trade-offs among deterministic automation, embedded SaaS AI, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows; know when AI should not be used.</li>
<li>Technical fluency: Understand large language model limitations, grounding, context design, APIs, integration platforms and permission-aware tool access. Be able to review prototypes and challenge architecture with engineering partners; model research expertise is not required.</li>
<li>Evaluation and economics: Define representative test cases, quality thresholds, failure modes, human review requirements and production monitoring. Compare business value with implementation, usage, maintenance and oversight costs.</li>
<li>Responsible AI: Recognize risks including inaccurate outputs, sensitive-data exposure, prompt injection, excessive permissions and overreliance. Translate risk findings into controls and deployment decisions with the appropriate specialists.</li>
<li>Adoption leadership: Teach teams how to use approved AI capabilities responsibly, redesign workflows around them and validate sustained benefits.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Enterprise Applications &amp; Leadership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Substantial progressive experience leading enterprise applications or business systems, including people leadership, portfolio ownership and cross-functional transformation.</li>
<li>Strong Salesforce ecosystem knowledge and experience connecting revenue and finance processes across enterprise systems.</li>
<li>Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into roadmaps, investment decisions and reliable delivery.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of integration architecture, data governance, secure application lifecycle practices, change management and operational resilience.</li>
<li>Commercial discipline in budgeting, vendor negotiations, licensing and value realization.</li>
<li>Clear executive communication, strong stakeholder management and the ability to build trust while challenging assumptions.</li>
<li>Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Experience</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Leadership in a SaaS or similarly fast-changing business environment.</li>
<li>Experience with quote-to-cash, customer lifecycle and financial operations transformation.</li>
<li>Exposure to Workato, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude Enterprise or comparable enterprise AI and automation capabilities; tool familiarity alone does not establish AI proficiency.</li>
<li>Relevant application, architecture, change management or AI governance certifications.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Success Measures</strong></p>
<p>Set baselines and agree targets with business owners after assessing the portfolio. The following are proposed measures, not existing commitments.</p>
<p><strong>Outcome</strong></p>
<p><strong>Evidence of Success</strong></p>
<p><strong>Business value</strong><br>Validated reduction in manual effort, process cycle time or rework; benefits confirmed by the business owner and separated from estimates.</p>
<p><strong>AI quality and adoption</strong><br>Useful production adoption, evaluation results, exception rates and sustained workflow improvements—not pilot counts alone.</p>
<p><strong>Platform health</strong><br>Service reliability, incident recovery, release quality and reductions in technical debt and integration failures.</p>
<p><strong>Governance and data</strong><br>Documented ownership, completed risk reviews, effective controls, audit readiness and improvements in critical data quality.</p>
<p><strong>Financial discipline</strong><br>Transparent portfolio spend, improved license utilization and realized value relative to total operating cost.</p>
<p><strong>Delivery and capability</strong><br>Predictable delivery, stakeholder confidence, clear accountability and stronger application and AI skills across the team.</p>
<p><strong>Initial Priorities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>First 30 days: Assess business priorities, application ownership, team capabilities, architecture, spend and critical risks; establish baseline measures.</li>
<li>Days 31–60: Agree portfolio priorities, clarify decision rights with IT and Enterprise AI Engineering, and select a small set of high-value AI or automation opportunities.</li>
<li>Days 61–90: Establish delivery and governance routines; advance a selected use case through evaluation and readiness review, with adoption and measurement plans.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>Base Salary Range: <span class="collapsed-field-text">$211,085.25 - $309,591.70</span>. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). <span>#Li-remote</span></p>

We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

      <title>ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Senior Director, Product Management, Agentic Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote-US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.</p></div><div>
<p class="markdown-p">ZoomInfo has rebuilt itself around AI, and every agentic experience we ship runs on one shared platform — Copilot chat, agent teams, bots, GTM Studio, MarketingOS, and products that don't exist yet. As Senior Director of Product Management for the Agentic Platform, you'll be the right hand to our VP of Agents &amp; Orchestration, owning the core primitives every agent depends on and the forward-looking R&amp;D that keeps our agents ahead of what off-the-shelf models and frameworks can do. The best practices for agentic platforms are being written right now, and you'll help write them.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You will set the multi-year Agentic Platform strategy and turn it into a roadmap that balances reliability, speed for product teams, and bets on the frontier.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own core platform primitives — multi-agent orchestration, planning and execution runtimes, memory and context management, tool and MCP infrastructure, guardrails, and observability — and define the abstractions that let product teams compose new agents quickly.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will lead the product side of custom model training and fine-tuning on ZoomInfo's proprietary data, deciding where custom models create lasting advantage versus frontier models.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will build the decisioning-model layer that lets agents choose the right action, partnering with data science to turn ZoomInfo's signals into models agents invoke as first-class capabilities.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will run a structured orchestration R&amp;D program that tracks emerging research and moves the winners into production.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will identify and ship net-new platform capabilities that unlock new product surfaces and revenue, taking ideas from whiteboard sketch to production primitive.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will partner with engineering to make agent infrastructure production-grade — measurable on execution at scale, latency, cost per task, security, and compliance.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will build and grow a team of senior and principal PMs, hiring for technical depth and ownership and developing leaders who run their own areas with the same bar you hold.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">At least 10 years building technical products, including at least 3 years leading teams of PMs or running a company</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Deep, hands-on experience with production agentic systems — agents that plan, invoke tools, and take real actions, not just chat interfaces</li>
<li class="markdown-li">A track record of taking an AI or agentic product from 0→1, either as a founder or as the product leader who owned it end to end</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Fluency across the modern agentic stack, including orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom), MCP and tool-calling patterns, RAG and memory architectures, and evals and observability</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Enough technical depth to review architecture docs, read agent traces, and prototype in code yourself</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">Working knowledge of model development, including fine-tuning, post-training, evaluation design, and the economics of custom versus frontier models</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Experience building platform products where engineering and product teams are your customers</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Experience shipping decisioning, ranking, or recommendation models into production</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Experience in B2B, GTM, or data platform businesses</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-Remote</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-VC1</p>

Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position. <p>ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yiG-k0YX_sW10PiJk_xliDc3W-veJCrK/view?usp=drive_link">Privacy Notice</a> for more details on how we handle your personal information.</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US or Canada - Remote
</p>

<p>Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. We’ve built a product that users love, and we plan to keep it that way by continuing to empathize with users and help them overcome their most significant challenges. <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>The Responsible AI team is part of<strong> </strong>the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.</p>
<p>At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.</p>
<p>Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable <a href="https://newsroom.pinterest.com/en/post/pinterest-expands-the-skin-tone-range-feature-to-more-countries">skin tone</a>, <a href="https://newsroom.pinterest.com/en-gb/post/pinterest-introduces-first-of-its-kind-hair-pattern-search-for-inclusive-beauty-results">hair pattern</a> search refinements, and more recently, <a href="https://newsroom.pinterest.com/news/pinterests-new-body-type-ranges-deliver-better-more-inclusive-search-results/">body type</a>.</p>
<p>You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.</li>
<li>Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.</li>
<li>Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.</li>
<li>Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.</li>
<li>Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.</li>
<li>2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products</li>
<li>Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields</li>
<li><strong>Nice to have:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Publications at top ML conferences</li>
<li>Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring</li>
<li>Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration</li>
<li>Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data</li>
<li>Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product<br><br></li>
</ul>
</li>

      <title>Carrot: Manager, Product Design</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Product Designer and Product Design</skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Carrot: </strong></p>
<p><a href="https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&amp;l=en&amp;o=4420559-1&amp;h=3535232987&amp;u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.carrotfertility.com%2F&amp;a=Carrot+Fertility">Carrot</a> is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.<br><br>Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at <a href="http://get-carrot.com">get-carrot.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>The Opportunity </strong><strong></strong></p>
<p>Carrot’s User Experience team is seeking a Manager, Product Design to lead a team of senior product designers building our member-facing products. You’ll lead project work, raise the craft bar through direct feedback, and help our design function evolve as AI tools reshape the boundaries between design, product management, and engineering. You’ll partner with Content Design, Product Management, and Engineering leaders to deliver products that scale our impact to members worldwide.</p>
<p>This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes to hands-on design work, including design system and foundational direction, and half to leading and coaching the team. If you love sharpening experienced designers’ work, designing for a diverse set of member needs across all paths to parenthood, and shaping how a design team works in an AI-enabled future, this role is for you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Own&nbsp;</strong><strong></strong></p>
<p>In this role, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead design initiatives from strategy to launch, ensuring work meets project goals, timelines, and business priorities.</li>
<li>Give clear, actionable craft feedback through critiques and design reviews, holding a high bar for quality, consistency, and accessibility.</li>
<li>Contribute hands-on design, prototypes, or direction on complex, high-visibility initiatives, including design system and foundational work.</li>
<li>Coach designers to plan and run their own research, from study design through synthesis, and ensure qualitative and quantitative evidence shapes design decisions.</li>
<li>Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on goals, scope, and delivery, and communicate the team’s results and design rationale to senior stakeholders.</li>
<li>Drive adoption of AI tools that help designers work faster, more consistently, and with greater capacity, and evaluate what works.</li>
<li>Help redefine how design works with product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and recommend process changes to the product development lifecycle.</li>
<li>Hold regular 1:1s and coach designers on craft, influence, and career growth, tied to Carrot’s leveling framework.</li>
<li>Own performance management, including goal-setting, reviews, and calibration input, and address gaps directly and fairly.</li>
<li>Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture where designers feel ownership of their work.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What Success Looks Like </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>In your first 12–18 months, you will have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Delivered design work on high-visibility initiatives that met project goals, timelines, and business priorities.</li>
<li>Established a critique and design review rhythm that has visibly raised the quality, consistency, and accessibility of what the team ships.</li>
<li>Introduced AI tools and practices that improved the team’s speed, consistency, or capacity, and helped clarify how design works with product and engineering as roles shift.</li>
<li>Built a research practice in which designers plan and run their own studies, and evidence shapes design decisions.</li>
<li>Coached each designer with clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path tied to Carrot’s leveling framework, and built a team culture where designers feel ownership of their work.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About You </strong><strong></strong></p>
<p>You likely have:</p>
<ul>
<li>A Bachelor’s degree</li>
<li>10+ years in product design or UX/UI, including 2+ years managing designers.</li>
<li>A portfolio of shipped, user-centered, member- or consumer-facing digital products, with evidence of leading a team’s output.</li>
<li>A track record of coaching experienced designers, giving direct craft feedback, and handling performance conversations.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype and ship design work, and helping a team adapt its practices as roles evolve.</li>
<li>Experience evolving a design system in collaboration with engineers, ideally across multiple products.</li>
<li>Strong knowledge of interaction design, visual design, WCAG accessibility, and responsive and mobile design.</li>
<li>Experience planning and running user research, from interviews and usability testing to quantitative analysis, and coaching designers to do the same.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills, including influencing senior stakeholders and articulating design rationale.</li>
<li>Comfort with ambiguity and change in a fast-paced agile environment, with clear trade-off decisions.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Nice to Have </strong><strong>⭐</strong></p>
<p>While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing configuration-driven products, where rules and settings (such as eligibility or plan rules) determine what each person sees.</li>
<li>Familiarity with the healthcare industry, insurance, finance, and compliance, alongside sensitivity to the challenges of fertility health and family forming around the world.</li>
<li>Familiarity with front-end development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to collaborate effectively with engineers.</li>
<li>Experience managing distributed or global teams across time zones.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record with strategic headcount allocation, resource budgeting, and external partner management.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>Why This Role Matters </strong><strong></strong></p>
<p>Carrot’s members come to us at some of the most personal and consequential moments of their lives, across every path to parenthood and lifelong fertility healthcare. The quality of our design shapes whether they feel understood, supported, and able to get the care they need.</p>
<p>At the same time, the way design teams work is changing quickly. You’ll help define how a senior team adopts AI tools, how design works alongside product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and what great craft looks like in that environment, while staying close to the work yourself.</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>Interview Process </strong><strong></strong></p>
<p>We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.</p>
<p>For this role, candidates can expect:</p>
<ol>
<li>Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes</li>
<li>Hiring Manager Interview — 30 minutes</li>
<li>Portfolio Review Interview— 60 minutes</li>
<li>Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes</li>
</ol>
<p>Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why Candidates Join Carrot </strong></p>
<p>Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.</p>
<p>Highlights include:</p>
<ul>
<li>A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.</li>
<li>A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.</li>
<li>Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.</li>
<li>Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.</li>
<li>A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.</li>
<li>The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation </strong></p>
<p>Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.&nbsp;Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot’s long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Base Salary Range:</strong> $162,000- $190,000</li>
<li><strong>Geo-Tier Adjustment:</strong> Up to $200,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fraud and Security Notice: </strong>Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: <a href="mailto:securityreporting@get-carrot.com">securityreporting@get-carrot.com</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>A Note on AI</strong></p>
<p>At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.</p>
<p>For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Carrot?</strong></p>
<p>Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p></div>

      <title>Gusto, Inc.: Staff Product Designer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Product Designer and Product Design</skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>About Gusto</strong></p>
<p>At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.</p>
<p>All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards"> Total Rewards philosophy</a>.</p>
<p>AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p>
<p>Gusto’s looking to bring on several Staff Product Designers across our Money and HR Experience product organizations. These teams sit on some of the highest-stakes, most AI-native surfaces at Gusto, where small businesses make financial and people decisions that carry real impact, and where getting the experience right is what builds durable trust. That's exactly why judgment, taste, and craft matter here.</p>
<p>As a Staff Product Designer, you'll own experiences end to end within a specific domain, turning ambiguity into clear, trustworthy products and helping define patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto. You'll be deeply embedded in the product quartet, driving design decisions in partnership with Product Managers and Engineers, and demonstrating high craft and storytelling every step of the way.</p>
<p><strong>This is one job posting for five open roles in Gusto Money, Banking, and HR Experiences product orgs. </strong>You'll be matched to the opportunity that best fits your strengths and interests. Here are the teams currently hiring:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Consumer Banking: </strong>Consumer Banking builds financial products for the millions of employees paid through Gusto, anchored to Gusto Wallet — spend accounts, savings goals, paycheck splitting, and on-demand access to earned wages. Because Gusto runs payroll, the team sits at the source of income itself, helping workers smooth cash flow between paychecks, save automatically, and avoid predatory alternatives like payday lenders and overdraft fees. One of the fastest-growing engines in Gusto Banking, it moves at a startup pace while incubating 0→1 foundational technology in a regulated space where trust, reliability, and craft are everything.</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Gusto Money: </strong>MoneyOS is the team within Gusto Money focused on helping small businesses better understand, manage, and improve their financial position. This is an especially exciting moment for the team. The space is still taking shape, which means there’s real room to define the product, the patterns, and the customer expectations. MoneyOS works at the intersection of product strategy, financial systems, customer trust, and emerging AI-native ways of building—making it a strong fit for a designer who wants to have outsized influence on both what we build and how we build it.</p>
</li>
<li><strong>HR Experiences (HRX):</strong> HRX helps small businesses get expert HR help right inside the product — a customer simply says what they need, and Gusto takes the action, answers the question, or brings in a human expert when the stakes are high. You'll design AI-native experiences across a two-sided service — the everyday self-serve moments, the AI that guides and does the work, and the human HR experts who step in when it matters most — so it all feels like one Gusto, in a domain where judgment and trust matter enormously.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Here's what you'll do day-to-day:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own design end to end in your domain — from framing ambiguous problems to shipping high-craft, accessible experiences that hide the underlying complexity from customers.</li>
<li>Shape goals, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with your PM and engineering lead, balancing customer trust, business value, and technical realities.</li>
<li>Translate ambiguous, often 0→1 strategy into clear scopes, flows, and interaction patterns — including patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto.</li>
<li>Design the experience of AI thoughtfully — representing uncertainty, surfacing errors gracefully, preserving customer agency, and knowing when a human should step in.</li>
<li>Ground your decisions in customer insight, leading or partnering on research, competitive audits, and hypothesis-driven exploration in high-stakes, sometimes compliance-sensitive domains.</li>
<li>Raise the craft and systems bar, evolving Gusto's design system where existing patterns fall short.</li>
<li>Work in fast cycles and use AI tools in your own practice — set a clear target, prototype and ship real things to customers, and let what you learn sharpen the direction.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Here's what we're looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years of product design experience owning and shipping end-to-end work, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another high-trust domain, with strong craft across web.</li>
<li>Experience designing AI-enabled or conversational experiences shipped to real users, and you can speak concretely to how you handled uncertainty, errors, and human override.</li>
<li>Comfort with ambiguity and 0→1, you frame the problem, scope the work, and move forward without waiting for perfect information.</li>
<li>Strong systems thinking, you use and contribute to a design system and know when to evolve it.</li>
<li>Judgment to evaluate and direct AI outputs, when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the bar, especially where the cost of being wrong is high.</li>
<li>Strong collaboration and communication across design, product, engineering, and data.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p>

We're growing our team to bring the construction drawing stage in-house on an offshore basis, freeing up our local design team to focus on new client work while drawings progress in the background.</p><p></p><p>ROLE OVERVIEW:</p><p>We're looking for a skilled CAD draftsperson to take finalised landscape design concepts and turn them into accurate, buildable construction drawing sets. This is a genuine long-term team role, not a one-off gig - we're investing in someone who wants to grow with the business, not just complete tasks.</p><p>The ideal candidate is confident in producing both construction drawings and photorealistic renders, giving us a single point of contact who can carry a project from concept through to construction-ready documentation.</p><p></p><p>RESPONSIBILITIES:</p><ul><li>Convert approved concept designs into detailed, accurate construction drawing sets (setout plans, levels, sections, details, planting plans, and material schedules).</li><li>Work primarily in Vectorworks to ensure drawings are consistent with the client's existing file standards and templates.</li><li>Produce photorealistic or presentation-quality renders to support client approvals, where required.</li><li>Liaise with Drew and the local design team to clarify design intent, resolve details, and incorporate feedback.</li><li>Maintain drawing accuracy for levels, drainage falls, and material junctions so drawings are genuinely buildable on site.</li><li>Manage your own workflow and deadlines across multiple concurrent projects, flagging risks or delays early.</li><li>Keep drawing files, layers, and naming conventions organised and consistent across projects.</li></ul>
<ul><li>Proven, verifiable proficiency in Vectorworks is strongly preferred.</li><li>Candidates with strong experience in SketchUp, Revit, or AutoCAD will also be considered - we're open to supporting a transition to Vectorworks.</li><li>Background in landscape architecture, landscape design, or architectural drafting, ideally with residential project experience.</li><li>Understanding of construction documentation: setout, levels, sections, details, and materials - not just drafting for visual presentation.</li><li>Rendering skills (e.g, Enscape, D5) are a strong advantage.</li><li>Strong written English for clear communication with the Australian-based team.</li><li>Reliable internet connection and the ability to work overlapping hours with an Australian (Melbourne, AEST/AEDT) team.</li></ul><p>What We're Looking For</p><p>Technical skill matters, but it's not the only thing we're hiring for. We value:</p><ul><li>Genuine attention to detail - drawings that are accurate the first time, not just "close enough."</li><li>Strong work ethic and reliability - someone who owns their workload and communicates proactively.</li><li>A long-term mindset - we're looking to invest in this role and grow it over time, not treat it as disposable outsourced labour.</li><li>Honesty about your actual skill level and software experience - we'd rather know upfront than discover gaps later.</li></ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-draftsperson-construction-drawings-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-draftsperson-construction-drawings-specialist</a></p>

      <title>Elation Health: Head of Design</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<p>Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.</p>
<p>Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.</p>
<p>Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.</p>
<h2>The opportunity</h2>
<p>As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.</p>
<p>You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.</li>
<li>Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.</li>
<li>Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.</li>
<li>Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.</li>
<li>Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.</li>
<li>Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.</li>
<li>Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.</li>
<li>Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.</li>
<li>Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.</li>
<li>Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.</li>
<li>Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What success looks like</h2>
<p>We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:</p>
<ul>
<li>Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.</li>
<li>Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.</li>
<li>The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.</li>
<li>Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.</li>
<li>Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What we’re looking for</h2>
<ul>
<li>Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.</li>
<li>A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.</li>
<li>Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.</li>
<li>Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.</li>
<li>Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.</li>
<li>A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.</li>
<li>The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.</li>
<li>A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.</li>
<li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable</strong></p>
<hr>
<p>Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.</p>
<p>We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.</p>
<p>Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We're transforming the grocery industry</strong></p>
<p><span class="im">At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.</span></p>
<p>Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.</p>
<p><strong>Instacart is a Flex First team </strong></p>
<p>There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. <a href="https://www.instacart.careers/flex-first">Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.</a></p></div><h2><strong>Overview</strong></h2>
<p>The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist II with a strong quantitative background to join our team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About the Job</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.</li>
<li>Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.</li>
<li>Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.</li>
<li>Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>Minimum Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>PhD in operations research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.</li>
<li>Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.</li>
<li>Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Preferred Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.</li>
<li>Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.</li>
<li>Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.</li>
<li>Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy <a href="https://instacart.careers/flex-first/">here</a>. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.</p>
<p>Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings <a href="https://instacart.careers/taste-of-instacart/">here</a>.</p>
<p>For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.</p></div><div class="title">CAN</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$154,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$162,500 CAD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instacart-applied-scientist-ii-advertiser-optimization">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instacart-applied-scientist-ii-advertiser-optimization</a></p>

      <title>6sense: Business Solutions Partner - Enterprise AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇨🇷 Costa Rica</country>

      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Costa Rica, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p>
<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. &nbsp;Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.&nbsp; 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.&nbsp; We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner</strong></p>
<p>Business Solutions Partner — GTM &amp; Finance Systems</p>
<p><strong>Location</strong><br>Costa Rica&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Function / Dept</strong><br>Business Technology — Enterprise Applications</p>
<p><strong>Reports to</strong><br>Director, Enterprise Applications</p>
<p><strong>Position Summary</strong></p>
<p>6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals.</p>
<p>This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes.</p>
<p>Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies.</p>
<p>A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences.</p>
<p>This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p><strong>Tool Inventory &amp; AI Efficiency Discovery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility.</li>
<li>Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings.</li>
<li>Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time.</li>
<li>Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature.</li>
<li>Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Build-vs-Buy Analysis &amp; Business Cases</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope.</li>
<li>Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side.</li>
<li>Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later.</li>
<li>Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Prototyping &amp; Applied AI</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved.</li>
<li>Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases.</li>
<li>Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production.</li>
<li>Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled.</li>
<li>Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Stakeholder Partnership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status.</li>
<li>Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on.</li>
<li>Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition.</li>
<li>Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Hands-On Salesforce &amp; Delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones.</li>
<li>Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers.</li>
<li>Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Measurement &amp; Ways of Working</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired.</li>
<li>Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated.</li>
<li>Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve.</li>
<li>Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company.</li>
<li>Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting.</li>
<li>Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role.</li>
<li>Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits.</li>
<li>Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem.</li>
<li>Process mapping and structured interviewing skills.</li>
<li>Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders.</li>
<li>Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result.</li>
<li>Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations.</li>
<li>Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period.</li>
<li>Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance.</li>
<li>Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist.</li>
<li>Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar.</li>
<li>Bilingual English/Spanish.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we value</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document.</li>
<li>Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate.</li>
<li>Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How This Role Is Measured</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function.</li>
<li>Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date.</li>
<li>Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead.</li>
<li>Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner.</li>
<li>Adoption of anything shipped in your function.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p>
<p><strong>First 90 days</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners.</li>
<li>Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential.</li>
<li>Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities.</li>
<li>First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>First year</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating.</li>
<li>At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact.</li>
<li>At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number.</li>
<li>Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each.</li>
<li>You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span>Our Benefits:</span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth.
